summary: Armlogi Holding Corp. filed an 8-K to disclose Nasdaq's approval of its transfer from The Nasdaq Global Market to The Nasdaq Capital Market, granting a second 180-day compliance period until November 2, 2026, to cure a bid price deficiency under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The company also automatically regains compliance with the Market Value of Publicly Held Shares requirement upon transfer. No reverse stock split has been effected yet. The filing is a routine listing transfer and compliance update, not a special situation event.
